# Templates

Whole-page wireframes such as blog, cart and landing.

## What's here

Each file exports a `paint` function that colors one page type.

## How it connects

- Part of [Blockframes](../README.md); `Painter.js` picks the right file by block class name.

## See also

- [Blockframes](../README.md)
